label: Delimiter and first copy step in long sequences
explanation: Fires at the start of the copy phase: the <DEL> step (recall_idx 0; 36% of DEL steps active, 67% of mass) and the next step (recall_idx 1; 27% of mass). It is strongest for long sequences (L=8-9 hold 79% of mass; rate is near zero for L<=5). It is almost never active during the original phase and rarely later in the copy phase. Top activations are at <DEL> with the first original token output next, and they decay over the following 1-2 copy steps. Magnitude also depends on which token is being output: c, d, f, l, n, v, w are higher (out_tok lift ~2.6-3.4x) and p, z, k, m, b are lower. A token-set filter did not improve F1, so it is a graded modulation rather than a gate. Many delimiter steps in long sequences stay inactive (precision ~0.5).
